description: Canonical source record for the Programmes section's page content. WordPress is the runtime editor; these files are the recoverable source. Not loaded by WordPress. Block markup in each source file is exactly what the block editor stores in post_content. Entries without a source set page fields only (the proposition, moment and related Solutions the Programmes register reads). Programmes without their own content carry template and fields only, so the family template gives them their hero, the other programmes and the footer.

meta.summit_standfirst: Some decisions call for a fresh view. Others need several disciplines working together over time.
meta.summit_intro:
Our programmes give that work a clear starting point. Each is shaped around a specific institutional or commercial need, with the right people involved and an agreed scope of work.

Begin with what needs attention. We can decide together whether a programme is the appropriate answer.

meta.summit_summary: A structured programme for younger luxury brands building the institutional architecture required to become enduring maisons.
meta.summit_moment: When a younger luxury brand must decide what kind of house it intends to become.
meta.summit_standfirst: A brand can find an audience quickly. A maison takes longer to build.
meta.summit_intro: Maison Formation brings brand position, commercial architecture, product discipline, experience, rights and patrimony into one coherent proposition. The aim is not simply to launch. It is to establish what deserves to survive success.

meta.summit_summary: A programme to determine what is worth saying, create something worth reading, and place it before the people worth reaching.
meta.summit_moment: When the story of the house is being told more often by others than by the house itself.
meta.summit_standfirst: Attention is easy to buy. Authority is harder to earn.
meta.summit_intro: Editorial & Influence helps a business develop a position worth publishing, substantiate it and make it useful to the people it wants to reach. The work begins with what the organisation has a right to say, not how often it can post.

meta.summit_summary: A programme for growing digital demand and commerce without surrendering the scarcity, service or presentation that define the house.
meta.summit_moment: When digital demand must grow without the house becoming ordinary online.
meta.summit_standfirst: More traffic means little if the wrong people arrive, the experience disappoints them or the sale costs the house more than it earns.
meta.summit_intro: Digital Growth examines how a luxury business attracts interest, earns confidence and converts demand without trading away price integrity or control of its client relationships.

meta.summit_summary: A programme for aligning product, place, service and digital encounter so every contact carries the authority of the house.
meta.summit_moment: When the encounter with the house falls short of what it makes.
meta.summit_standfirst: A client meets a maison long before entering a boutique and remembers it long after buying.
meta.summit_intro:
Client Experience brings the house’s character into the moments that shape trust: discovery, conversation, purchase, delivery, aftercare and the relationship that follows.

The standard is consistency without sameness.

meta.summit_summary: A programme for applying intelligent agents where they extend service and judgement without outsourcing the maison’s voice.
meta.summit_moment: When a house is weighing where intelligent agents belong, and where they do not.
meta.summit_standfirst: Not every task deserves an agent. Some should remain firmly in human hands.
meta.summit_intro:
Agentic AI explores where systems can carry out defined sequences of work — retrieving, checking, preparing or routing information — with permissions, records and human approval appropriate to the risk.

The question is not what can be automated. It is what should be.

meta.summit_summary: A programme for governing the marks, designs, archives and patrimony that carry a house over time.
meta.summit_moment: When the marks, designs and archives that carry the house need governing, not only registering.
meta.summit_standfirst: A signature, archive or skill may carry a maison long after the campaign that first made it visible.
meta.summit_intro:
Brand & IP Stewardship brings institutional identity into conversation with rights, provenance, creative practice and the decisions that either preserve or weaken a house over time.

Protection begins before a dispute. Stewardship continues after it.
